properties.name: AnalysisLevel
properties.doc: Which set of the .NET analyzer rules is on: a version, optionally with a mode (latest-recommended).

properties.name: AnalysisMode
properties.doc: How many of the rules are on.

properties.name: EnableNETAnalyzers
properties.doc: The code quality analyzers of the SDK (CAxxxx).

properties.name: EnforceCodeStyleInBuild
properties.doc: The code style rules (IDExxxx) of .editorconfig are checked by the build too.

properties.name: RunAnalyzers
properties.doc: false: no analyzers at all, at build and in the IDE.

properties.name: RunAnalyzersDuringBuild
properties.doc: false: a faster build, the analyzers run in the IDE only.

properties.name: RunAnalyzersDuringLiveAnalysis
properties.doc: false: the analyzers run at build only.

properties.name: CodeAnalysisTreatWarningsAsErrors
properties.doc: false: CA warnings stay warnings under TreatWarningsAsErrors.

properties.name: ReportAnalyzer
properties.doc: Report how long each analyzer and generator has taken.

properties.name: ErrorLog
properties.doc: Write the diagnostics to a SARIF file: build.sarif,version=2.1.

properties.name: GenerateDocumentationFile
properties.doc: Needed by the rules about XML comments and by IDE0005 (unused usings) at build.
